game.title: Blockmancer
game.subtitle: Daily run · same pieces for everyone

offers.startSubtitle: Jokers work in pairs. You pick one more after every round, so plan your build.
offers.nextRound: Pick a joker. Next: round $index · $target pts.
offers.nextBoss: Pick a joker. Next: Boss · $target pts with stones.

stonemason.name: Stonemason
stonemason.description: +50 chips for each stone cleared. 2 extra stones every round.

combo.name: Combo King
combo.description: +1 mult for every clearing move in a row.

patience.name: Patience
patience.description: Each move without a clear stores +2 mult for your next clear.

precision.name: Precision
precision.description: +6 mult when a 1–2 cell piece completes a line.

collector.name: Collector
collector.description: +1 mult on every clear for each joker you own.

twin.name: Twin Lines
twin.description: ×3 mult when you clear 2 or more lines at once.

column.name: Column Hunter
column.description: ×2 mult when your move clears a column.

heavy.name: Heavyweight
heavy.description: ×2 mult when a piece of 4+ cells completes a line.

sweep.name: Clean Sweep
sweep.description: +500 points when the board becomes completely empty.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: Every clear drops a new stone on a random empty cell.

bigbox.name: Big Box
bigbox.description: Pieces of 5+ cells show up 3× more often.

tiny.name: Tiny Tools
tiny.description: Pieces of 1–2 cells show up 3× more often.

saver.name: Saver
saver.description: Each unused piece when you beat a round gives +40 run points.

push.channelDescription: News and messages from the app.
